#302 · November 9, 2026


This week: our free generative media course starting next week, Project 2 in AI Dev Tools Zoomcamp, the Machine Learning Zoomcamp midterm, a Q&A and launch stream, two recordings, and Alexey's post on dark software factories.

 

Production AI Agents for Generative Media 2026 Cohort

What happens when your agent launches expensive, slow GPU jobs that can fail? Production AI Agents for Generative Media starts next week, on November 16.


In this free course with Nebius, you build a Personalized Media Factory:

  • Run image, video, and audio models as serverless GPU Jobs and Endpoints

  • Give an agent GPU models as tools, with evaluation guiding regeneration

  • Scale to batches with a cost line per asset


The materials are open to everyone. Selected participants also get homework, peer review, and the capstone. 728 people have already registered.

Register now
 

Project 2

This is the last week for Project 2, the second attempt at the final project.


Submissions close on November 17, 2026 at 00:00 CET. Check what to build and how it's scored before you submit.


After the deadline, you review three projects from other participants. Reviews are due November 24, 2026 at 00:00 CET.

Submit your project

Midterm Project

This is the second and last week of the midterm project. Submissions are due November 17, 2026, at 00:00 CET. Check the project guidelines before you submit.


You don't need to find reviewers in Slack: after the form closes, the course platform assigns you three projects to review. Reviews are mandatory and due November 24, 2026 at 00:00 CET.

Submit your midterm project

Q&A, Launch Stream, and Module 1

Still deciding if the course is for you? Join the Pre-Course Live Q&A on November 10. Alexey Grigorev, Mikhail Rozhkov, and Marouane Khoukh will explain what you'll build, who the course is for, the prerequisites, and how to apply. Bring your questions.


On November 16, we start together with the launch stream. Module 1 covers consistent media generation on serverless GPUs and runs for two weeks, so if you join a bit later, you still have time to catch up. Applications stay open until November 30.

Register for the Q&A

RECORDINGS

Workshop Recording: Build a Media Agent: CPU Agent, GPU Models as Tools

On November 3, Alexey Grigorev and Mikhail Rozhkov from Nebius ran a hands-on workshop on media agents. We built a small agent that runs on a CPU and calls GPU-hosted image models as tools:

  • Image generation endpoints as agent tools

  • Building and running the agent with Pydantic AI

  • Swapping the image model for Sana

  • Nebius Serverless AI: GPU endpoints, jobs, spot instances, and costs


This workshop previews Production AI Agents for Generative Media. If you missed the live session, the recording is ready.

 

READ

From Alexey on Data: Dark Software Factories

Do you still read every line of code your agents write?


In his new newsletter, Alexey explains why he stopped reading agent-generated code and looks at how teams run software factories:

  • Where the term "dark software factory" comes from

  • How teams run factories, from Sandstorm to Linear-to-PR

  • When agent factories still escalate to humans

  • The technical and comprehension debt factories create
